Done says a worker of the global dream has finished its part, and runs
the dream's next step in code: after the generator, the critic starts, on
the other model (or, with no ideas, the dream commits); after the critic,
the approved ideas are applied in order and the dream commits, or, if the
result breaks commit's guards, memory is put back and it is abandoned. The
critic's done refuses while an idea is unjudged. A dreamer commits
instead. Only a dream's generator or critic runs it.

Usage:
  agent dream done [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream done

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for done

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
